name: docjet-mcp
description: Render branded PDF documents (invoices, reports, certificates) and PNG social images from any MCP client. Send a template ID or raw HTML plus JSON data, get back a signed download URL.

environment.name: DOCJET_API_KEY
environment.description: DocJet API key (binfra_ prefix). Required for render_pdf and render_image.

environment.name: DOCJET_BASE_URL
environment.description: Override the API base URL (default: https://api.docjet.dev).

tools.name: render_pdf
tools.description: Render a branded PDF document. Provide a template_id (discover with list_templates) or raw html, plus a data object for template variables. Returns a signed download URL.

tools.name: render_image
tools.description: Render a PNG image (e.g. an OG/social card). Provide a template_id or raw html, plus a data object. Returns a signed download URL.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List available DocJet templates: id, name, description and outputType (pdf or png). No API key required.
